messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: HIGH - us-east-1d - increased 5xx and instance detach errors, impact on api/redwood-infer-prod. Pager metadata: alert=ec2-ebs-detach; severity=high; svc=api; runbook=/runbooks/az-failures

oncall-alex: on-call, reading in. visibility: sliding 5xx spike across ELB in us-east-1, some targets flapping unhealthy. starting triage.

sre-maya: seeing a bunch of EBS detach events in CloudTrail for instances in us-east-1d. Also 169.254.169.254 timeouts on affected hosts. snippet from one host dmesg:
```
[  123.456789] sd 0:0:0:0: [xvda] I/O error, dev xvda, sector 0
[  123.457000] Unable to read from the block device
[  124.000001] EBS: detach initiated by hypervisor due to ENI failure
```

eng-runtime-jordan: ELB target health shows transitions 0->unhealthy with HTTP code 502/504 from the nodes. NLB -> target group health is stuck for ~6m. curl from a healthy host to a failing instance returns TLS handshake timeout.

oncall-alex: AWS region console shows 'EC2 networking issue in us-east-1d' in the AWS Health Dashboard? Anyone confirm?

infra-bot: AWS Status: Confirmed: limited network connectivity to / from us-east-1d - "EC2 instances within affected AZ may experience connectivity issues". (automated message)

sre-maya: verified CloudWatch: network packet drops spike at 02:11 UTC for us-east-1d. ASG replaced ~12 instances in the group but they also fail to complete boot due to volume attach errors. EBS AttachVolume API errors: "Attachment failed due to network timeout".

eng-runtime-jordan: Route53 weighted records for api.redwood.com are still sending ~35% traffic to us-east-1 (weight=35), remaining to eu-west-1. Because ELB healthchecks for the weight/alias are based on region-level health checks with TTL 60s, propagation is lagging and customers still hit impacted AZ via the regional ELB.

oncall-alex: Mitigation plan: 1) Reduce route53 weight for us-east-1 to 0 temporarily. 2) Lower TTL on the record to 30s. 3) Force-disable us-east-1d AZ in our infra routing (remove AZ from NLB target groups). Who can run the change?

eng-runtime-jordan: I'll do Route53 weight change now. running:
```bash
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z123456 --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.com","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"us-east-1","Weight":0,"TTL":30,"AliasTarget":{"HostedZoneId":"Z2FDTNDATAQYW2","DNSName":"dualstack-api-us-east-1.elb.amazonaws.com","EvaluateTargetHealth":true}}}]}'
```

eng-runtime-jordan: change submitted, waiting for propagation.

infra-bot: Autoscaling action: scaled up eu-west-1 ASG by +6 (policy: cross-region soak). reason: shift traffic. (automated)

sre-maya: After weight=0, we see decrease in 5xx from global vantage and customer error rates drop by ~72% within two minutes. Still intermittent errors for sessions routed to existing TCP sessions in the AZ.

se-lee: Customer impact: Support triage shows ~28 customers observed errors in last 10 min, top 5 accounts affected: acme-inc, betaapps, fintech-gg, medsvc, edu-labs. We're drafting status page. Can we confirm ETA to full recovery or at least stable failover?

oncall-alex: Short term: failover complete for new sessions. Long term: AWS needs to remediate the AZ networking. Requesting AWS SR. I've opened a support case and put a note: "High - our production traffic impacted, us-east-1d networking causing EBS detach and instance failures."

sre-maya: AWS SR #123456789: engineer acknowledges and says their internal tooling shows an ENI control-plane degradation in us-east-1d. They will provide timeline. For now we should leave weight=0 and TTL low, and keep us-east-1d out of rotation.

eng-runtime-jordan: I manually deregistered targets in the NLB target groups for the us-east-1d instances to avoid slow connection draining causing persistent failures. command:
```bash
aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:... --targets Id=i-0123456789abcdef0
```

oncall-alex: Good. Also enabling an emergency config: set failure-mode to failover for route evaluation so Route53 won't evaluate alias health for that AZ for the next 60m (manual override).

infra-bot: Config change logged: route53 override applied by eng-runtime-jordan.

sre-maya: Logging next steps: 1) Keep weight=0 and TTL 30 for 1h. 2) AWS to confirm AZ health. 3) Rebalance EBS-backed instances out of us-east-1d later. 4) Postmortem to include why region-level healthcheck didn't evacuate faster.

se-lee: I'll push a status page update: "Partial outage in us-east-1 (AZ d) affecting some API requests. Traffic has been failed over to alternate regions; we're monitoring. No ETA for full restoration from AWS." Draft copied to #incidents-distro for review.

oncall-alex: Handoff: I need to go offline in 25 min. Handoff to @sre-maya for next 12h watch. @sre-maya, please own follow-up with AWS and the postmortem.

sre-maya: Acknowledged. I'll own follow-up. Logging: created follow-up ticket INF-4273 to rebalance EBS-backed pools and run cluster re-safety tests post-recovery.

eng-runtime-jordan: AWS update: They've marked the AZ as "impaired" and are performing remediation. They recommend not bringing volumes back until network stable. We'll keep weight=0 and TTL reduced until they confirm.

incident-bot: Incident annotated: incident_id=INC-2026-0421-01; severity=high; status=mitigated->monitoring. Pager silence set for 30m.

oncall-alex: Thanks team. I'm leaving notes and the runbook steps in the incident ticket. If AWS confirms full AZ recovery, we'll gradually reintroduce weight and re-register healthy targets after verification.

sre-maya: final note before handoff: customers on persisted connections may need to reconnect; recommend email to top 5 customers with steps and apology.

se-lee: will prepare customer comms, tagging account execs.

oncall-alex: Leaving handoff now. :phone: Handoff complete.

sre-maya: Monitoring charts show stable error rate ~baseline after failover. I'll keep updates in the ticket and follow up with a full postmortem.

incident-bot: Closing alert channel for this thread. Remember to run RCA template and include timeline and config diffs.
